title: test(gen): bill FFmpeg MCP usage for ag_ run tokens
author: iotserver24
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary
- Test the `/mcp/ffmpeg` route with an `ag_` agent run token.
- Verify the parent wallet pays the usage receipt and the upstream MCP never receives the bearer.

Addresses #14171 (MCP regression coverage only; live Floret verification and docs remain).
Fixes #15417.

## Test plan
- `cd gen.pollinations.ai && npx vitest run test/mcp-proxy.test.ts`

gist.headline: The receipt finds its hive
gist.blurb: A regression test now follows an ag_ agent run token through the FFmpeg MCP route, making sure the right wallet gets the tiny tab. The upstream service keeps its hands off the bearer token.
gist.summary: Added MCP proxy regression coverage verifying that `/mcp/ffmpeg` bills an `ag_` agent run token's parent wallet while withholding the bearer token from the upstream MCP.
gist.impact: This protects the FFmpeg MCP billing path so agent-run usage receipts stay attached to the parent wallet and upstream MCP services do not receive client bearer credentials.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy billing-and-routing scene: Polli, wearing a tiny accountant visor, guides a glowing usage receipt from an ag_ token to a parent-wallet flower pot while a friendly CRT monitor robot runs the FFmpeg route. A sealed bearer-token envelope remains safely outside the upstream MCP garden gate, with code-plants and soft lime-green terminal light reinforcing secure routing.
